blocks.zh: 配水系統之材料、表面處理與製造程序
blocks.en: Materials, Surface Finish and Fabrication of Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解高純度水配水系統對製造精度與表面處理的嚴格要求，以及為何管路製造必須在潔淨環境中進行
blocks.en: Understand the strict demands that high-purity water distribution systems place on fabrication precision and surface finish, and why piping fabrication must be carried out in a clean environment

blocks.zh: 掌握 316L 不鏽鋼的化學組成、耐蝕性原理，以及硫含量 (Sulfur) 對焊接與拋光的關鍵影響
blocks.en: Know the chemical composition of 316L stainless steel, why it resists corrosion, and the critical influence of sulfur content on welding and polishing

blocks.zh: 認識五大不鏽鋼腐蝕類型：晶間腐蝕、電偶腐蝕、接觸腐蝕、點蝕、應力腐蝕開裂
blocks.en: Recognize the five main types of stainless steel corrosion: intergranular corrosion, galvanic corrosion, contact corrosion, pitting, and stress corrosion cracking

blocks.zh: 學會鈍化 (Passivation) 與紅鏽 (Rouging) 的成因、識別與處理方法
blocks.en: Learn the causes, identification and treatment of passivation and rouging

blocks.zh: 比較固體拉製管 (Solid Drawn) 與焊縫管 (Welded Seam) 的差異，以及 PVDF 非金屬管路的適用情境
blocks.en: Compare solid drawn and welded seam tubing, and know when non-metallic PVDF piping is appropriate

blocks.zh: 掌握軌道焊接 (Orbital Welding) 的品質標準、焊工資格要求、內視鏡檢查 (Borescoping) 程序
blocks.en: Know the quality criteria for orbital welding, welder qualification requirements, and the borescoping procedure

blocks.zh: 辨識 14 種常見焊接缺陷及其根本原因與矯正措施
blocks.en: Identify 14 common weld defects together with their root causes and corrective actions

blocks.zh: 理解衛生夾具 (Sanitary Clamps) 的設計目的與應用場景
blocks.en: Understand the design purpose and typical applications of sanitary clamps

blocks.zh: 本章目錄 Chapter Contents
blocks.en: Chapter Contents

blocks.zh: 11.9.1 Introduction 11.9.1 簡介
blocks.en: 11.9.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 配水系統製造 (Distribution System Fabrication)：這不是普通的配管工程。ISPE 在開頭就強調「extreme care and precision」——製藥用高純度水的管路，每一個內部表面、每一條焊縫都必須達到近乎完美的光滑度。任何微小的縫隙 (crevice) 都可能成為微生物的溫床、腐蝕的起點、或微粒的來源。
blocks.en: Distribution system fabrication: This is not ordinary pipefitting. From the outset ISPE stresses "extreme care and precision": in pharmaceutical high-purity water piping, every internal surface and every weld must be close to perfectly smooth. Any tiny crevice can become a breeding ground for microorganisms, a starting point for corrosion, or a source of particles.

blocks.zh: 三大威脅：bacterial growth（微生物生長）、metal corrosion（金屬腐蝕）、particulate generation（微粒產生）。所有的材料選擇、焊接技術、環境控制，最終都是為了消滅這三個敵人。
blocks.en: Three threats: bacterial growth, metal corrosion, and particulate generation. Every choice of material, welding technique and environmental control ultimately aims to eliminate these three enemies.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在做心臟繞道手術——你植入的血管必須內壁完美光滑、不能有任何毛刺或接縫不良，否則血栓就會在那裡形成。高純度水管路就是製藥廠的「血管系統」，標準同樣嚴苛。而且，這個手術（安裝）還必須在無塵室裡進行，不能讓灰塵和油脂汙染「血管」內壁。
blocks.en: Imagine performing a heart bypass operation: the graft you implant must have a perfectly smooth inner wall with no burrs or poorly fitted joints, or a blood clot will form there. High-purity water piping is the "vascular system" of a pharmaceutical plant, and the standard is just as demanding. Moreover, this operation (installation) must be performed in a clean room, so that dust and grease do not contaminate the inner wall of the "blood vessel".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 注意 ISPE 特別指出「unlike the equipment selection」——管路製造比設備選型更講究。設備通常是整機採購，但管路是現場施工的，施工品質完全取決於：(1) 材料的化學組成是否一致 (2) 焊接是否在惰性氣體保護下進行 (3) 整個施工環境是否潔淨受控。這三個條件缺一不可。
blocks.en: Note that ISPE specifically says "unlike the equipment selection": piping fabrication demands more care than equipment selection. Equipment is usually purchased as a complete unit, but piping is built on site, so installation quality depends entirely on: (1) consistent chemical composition of the material, (2) welding under inert gas shielding, and (3) a clean, controlled working environment throughout. None of these three conditions can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 11.9.2 Materials of Construction 11.9.2 建造材質
blocks.en: 11.9.2 Materials of Construction

blocks.zh: 材料一致性原則：整個系統從配水管路、儲存槽到製程端，材料必須「consistent」。這不只是美觀問題——混用不同材質會產生電偶腐蝕 (Galvanic Corrosion)，就像把銅和鐵放在鹽水裡一樣會加速腐蝕。
blocks.en: Principle of material consistency: From the distribution piping to the storage tank and the point of use, the materials must be "consistent". This is not just a matter of appearance: mixing different materials causes galvanic corrosion, just as copper and iron placed in salt water corrode faster.

blocks.zh: 材料需承受的條件：蒸汽滅菌溫度 (121°C+)、清洗液 (CIP chemicals)、鈍化液 (passivation solutions)。材料必須在這些嚴苛條件下仍能維持耐腐蝕的表面品質。
blocks.en: Conditions the material must withstand: steam sterilization temperatures (121°C+), cleaning solutions (CIP chemicals), and passivation solutions. The material must keep its corrosion-resistant surface quality under these harsh conditions.

blocks.zh: ISPE 在這裡埋了一個重要伏筆：非金屬材料（即後文的 PVDF）在半導體業已經大量使用，且證明可以維持超高純度水的品質。這暗示製藥業可以向半導體業借鏡——事實上，半導體的水質要求比製藥還嚴格，所以半導體驗證過的材料在製藥業應該也適用。
blocks.en: ISPE plants an important hint here: non-metallic materials (the PVDF discussed later) are already widely used in the semiconductor industry and have been shown to maintain ultrapure water quality. This suggests that the pharmaceutical industry can learn from semiconductors. In fact, semiconductor water quality requirements are stricter than pharmaceutical ones, so materials proven in semiconductor service should also be suitable for pharmaceutical use.

blocks.zh: 11.9.3 Types of Stainless Steel & Corrosive Resistance 11.9.3 不鏽鋼類型與耐蝕性
blocks.en: 11.9.3 Types of Stainless Steel & Corrosive Resistance

blocks.zh: 耐蝕性三大元素
blocks.en: The Three Key Elements of Corrosion Resistance

blocks.zh: 鉻 (Cr) > 11.5%：形成鉻氧化物保護膜——這就是「不鏽鋼」之所以「不鏽」的根本原因。沒有足夠的鉻，就沒有這層保護膜。
blocks.en: Chromium (Cr) > 11.5%: forms a protective chromium oxide film, which is the fundamental reason "stainless" steel does not rust. Without enough chromium there is no protective film.

blocks.zh: 鎳 (Ni) > 7%：增強耐蝕性並改善延展性 (ductility)，使鋼材更容易成型和焊接。
blocks.en: Nickel (Ni) > 7%: improves corrosion resistance and ductility, making the steel easier to form and weld.

blocks.zh: 鉬 (Mo)：提高抗點蝕 (pitting) 能力，特別是在含氯環境中。316L 比 304L 多了 Mo，這就是為什麼 316L 是高純度水系統的首選。
blocks.en: Molybdenum (Mo): increases resistance to pitting, especially in chloride-containing environments. 316L contains Mo and 304L does not, which is why 316L is the first choice for high-purity water systems.

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼的鉻氧化物保護膜就像人體皮膚——健康的皮膚能抵擋外來感染。鉻含量不夠（低於 11.5%），就像皮膚有破口，細菌和腐蝕因子就能入侵。而「L」代表 Low Carbon，低碳含量減少了「碳化鉻」析出的風險，就像避免皮膚產生疤痕組織，讓保護層更完整。
blocks.en: The chromium oxide film on stainless steel is like human skin: healthy skin resists outside infection. If the chromium content is too low (below 11.5%), it is like a break in the skin, and bacteria and corrosive agents can get in. The "L" stands for Low Carbon; the low carbon content reduces the risk of chromium carbide precipitation, like avoiding scar tissue in the skin, so the protective layer stays more intact.

blocks.zh: 11.9.4 Weldability and Polishability 11.9.4 可焊性與可拋光性
blocks.en: 11.9.4 Weldability and Polishability

blocks.zh: 硫含量的兩難困境
blocks.en: The Sulfur Dilemma

blocks.zh: 硫 (Sulfur) 在不鏽鋼焊接中扮演矛盾角色：
blocks.en: Sulfur plays a contradictory role in stainless steel welding:

blocks.zh: 有利面：適量硫可改善加工性和焊接滲透性
blocks.en: The benefit: a moderate amount of sulfur improves machinability and weld penetration

blocks.zh: 不利面：硫會與錳結合形成 MnS 夾雜物，留在金屬表面成為腐蝕起點
blocks.en: The drawback: sulfur combines with manganese to form MnS inclusions, which remain at the metal surface and become corrosion initiation sites

blocks.zh: 最大風險：兩個配合件的硫含量不匹配 (mismatch) 時，焊接品質會嚴重劣化
blocks.en: The biggest risk: when the sulfur contents of two mating parts are mismatched, weld quality deteriorates severely

blocks.zh: 理想範圍：0.005% ~ 0.02%——這是 ISPE 給出的「黃金區間」，兼顧焊接品質與表面光潔度。
blocks.en: Ideal range: 0.005% to 0.02%. This is the "sweet spot" given by ISPE, balancing weld quality and surface finish.

blocks.zh: Heat Number 管理的實務重要性
blocks.en: Why Heat Number Control Matters in Practice

blocks.zh: 這是許多新進工程師容易忽略的關鍵點。316L 的規格範圍其實很寬——Cr 可以從 16% 到 18%，Mo 從 2% 到 3%——這些差異會顯著改變熔點。如果同一條管路上，管子是 Heat #A、彎頭是 Heat #B、閥門是 Heat #C，每換一個接頭就要重新調整焊接參數，品質一致性就很難保證。
blocks.en: This is a key point that many new engineers overlook. The 316L specification range is actually quite wide: Cr can range from 16% to 18% and Mo from 2% to 3%, and these differences significantly change the melting point. If, on the same line, the tube is Heat #A, the elbow is Heat #B and the valve is Heat #C, the welding parameters must be readjusted at every joint, and consistent quality is hard to guarantee.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：採購時要求同一管徑的所有零件（管材、管件、閥門）來自同一爐號 (Heat Number)。雖然閥門和管件的爐號較難控制，但至少管材應該統一。
blocks.en: Practical advice: At purchase, require that all components of the same size (tube, fittings, valves) come from the same heat number. Heat numbers for valves and fittings are harder to control, but at least the tubing should be uniform.

blocks.zh: Heat Number 就像烘焙時的麵粉批號。同一品牌的麵粉，不同批次的蛋白質含量可能略有不同。如果你做蛋糕時中途換了一批麵粉，烤出來的口感就會不一樣。焊接也是如此——同樣標稱 316L，不同爐號的鋼材在同樣的焊接參數下，熔融行為可能完全不同。所以要用「同一批麵粉」做完整個蛋糕。
blocks.en: A heat number is like the batch number of flour in baking. Different batches of flour from the same brand may differ slightly in protein content. If you switch flour batches halfway through making a cake, the texture will be different. Welding works the same way: even if all are nominally 316L, steel from different heats can melt quite differently under the same welding parameters. So use "the same batch of flour" for the whole cake.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果供應商無法提供同一 Heat Number 的管件和管材，你應該採取什麼補救措施？
blocks.en: If the supplier cannot provide fittings and tubing from the same heat number, what remedial measures should you take?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議硫含量上限改為 0.02% 而非原規格的 0.03%？對管路內壁品質有何影響？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend a sulfur upper limit of 0.02% instead of the original specification of 0.03%? What is the effect on the quality of the inner pipe wall?

blocks.zh: 11.9.5 Corrosion Hazards of Stainless Steels 11.9.5 不鏽鋼腐蝕危害
blocks.en: 11.9.5 Corrosion Hazards of Stainless Steels

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務警示
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Warning

blocks.zh: 接觸腐蝕是最容易在施工現場犯的錯誤。如果施工團隊之前在碳鋼管路上工作過，然後直接用同一套工具來處理不鏽鋼——磨輪上殘留的碳鋼微粒會嵌入不鏽鋼表面，形成腐蝕核。這就是為什麼 ISPE 後文要求「clean area devoid of any equipment previously used on carbon steels」。
blocks.en: Contact corrosion is the easiest mistake to make on a construction site. If the installation crew has previously worked on carbon steel piping and then uses the same tools on stainless steel, carbon steel particles left on the grinding wheel become embedded in the stainless steel surface and form corrosion nuclei. This is why ISPE later requires a "clean area devoid of any equipment previously used on carbon steels".

blocks.zh: 氯化物是不鏽鋼的天敵。在 CDMO 環境中，清洗液配方中如果含有次氯酸鈉 (NaClO)，使用後必須徹底沖洗，否則殘留的氯離子在管壁蒸發濃縮後會造成點蝕。高溫系統（WFI 循環）中的風險更高。
blocks.en: Chlorides are the natural enemy of stainless steel. In a CDMO environment, if a cleaning formulation contains sodium hypochlorite (NaClO), it must be rinsed out thoroughly after use. Otherwise residual chloride ions concentrate as they evaporate on the pipe wall and cause pitting. The risk is higher in hot systems (WFI loops).

blocks.zh: 想像不鏽鋼的鉻氧化物保護膜是盔甲。五種腐蝕就像五種不同的攻擊方式：晶間腐蝕是從盔甲接縫滲入（沿晶界）、電偶腐蝕是兩種金屬配對產生的「化學電池」自我攻擊、接觸腐蝕是敵方間諜（碳鋼碎片）混入我方陣營、點蝕是精準狙擊（氯離子找弱點）、應力開裂是在高壓下盔甲本身裂開。每種攻擊需要不同的防禦策略。
blocks.en: Imagine the chromium oxide film on stainless steel as armor. The five types of corrosion are like five different kinds of attack: intergranular corrosion seeps in through the seams of the armor (along grain boundaries); galvanic corrosion is a "chemical battery" created when two metals are paired, attacking itself; contact corrosion is an enemy spy (carbon steel fragments) infiltrating our ranks; pitting is a precise sniper shot (chloride ions finding a weak spot); and stress corrosion cracking is the armor itself splitting under high stress. Each attack needs a different defensive strategy.

blocks.zh: 11.9.6 Corrosion Protection, Passivation & Rouging 11.9.6 防蝕、鈍化與變色
blocks.en: 11.9.6 Corrosion Protection, Passivation & Rouging

blocks.zh: 鈍化 (Passivation) 原理
blocks.en: The Principle of Passivation

blocks.zh: 鈍化不是「鍍」一層東西上去，而是利用化學方式（通常是硝酸或檸檬酸）清除表面的鐵、污染物和夾雜物，讓鉻原子暴露出來，在空氣中自然形成一層緻密的鉻氧化物 (Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>) 保護膜。
blocks.en: Passivation does not "plate" anything onto the surface. It uses a chemical treatment (usually nitric acid or citric acid) to remove iron, contaminants and inclusions from the surface, exposing the chromium atoms so that a dense protective film of chromium oxide (Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub>) forms naturally in air.

blocks.zh: 何時需要鈍化：
blocks.en: When passivation is needed:

blocks.zh: 新系統安裝完成後（管路焊接會破壞原有保護膜）
blocks.en: After a new system has been installed (pipe welding destroys the original protective film)

blocks.zh: 系統維修或改造後
blocks.en: After system repair or modification

blocks.zh: 發現紅鏽 (Rouge) 後
blocks.en: After rouge is found

blocks.zh: 定期預防性維護
blocks.en: As periodic preventive maintenance

blocks.zh: 紅鏽 (Rouge) 的分級與對策
blocks.en: Rouge Classification and Countermeasures

blocks.zh: 紅鏽的顏色是系統健康的「體溫計」：
blocks.en: The color of rouge is the "thermometer" of system health:

blocks.zh: 橙色/淺紅：早期 rouge，通常可以用酸洗擦拭去除，再做鈍化即可
blocks.en: Orange / light red: early-stage rouge, which can usually be removed by wiping with acid, followed by passivation

blocks.zh: 紅褐色：中期 rouge，需要化學清洗（CIP derouging）+ 重新鈍化
blocks.en: Reddish brown: mid-stage rouge, which requires chemical cleaning (CIP derouging) plus re-passivation

blocks.zh: 紫/藍/灰/黑：出現在蒸汽系統中的高溫 rouge，這些是 Fe3O4 (磁鐵礦) 形態，非常難以去除，可能需要刮除並重新電拋光
blocks.en: Purple / blue / gray / black: high-temperature rouge found in steam systems. This is in the Fe3O4 (magnetite) form, is very difficult to remove, and may require scraping off and re-electropolishing

blocks.zh: 實務經驗：在 CDMO 工廠中，WFI 高溫循環系統（80°C+）幾乎都會出現某種程度的 rouge。關鍵是建立定期監測和 derouging 計劃，而不是等到嚴重時才處理。
blocks.en: Practical experience: In a CDMO plant, hot WFI circulation systems (80°C+) almost always develop some degree of rouge. The key is to establish a regular monitoring and derouging plan rather than waiting until the problem is severe.

blocks.zh: 鈍化就像給鋼琴定期調音——鋼琴弦（不鏽鋼表面）在使用後會偏離最佳狀態，調音師（鈍化程序）把它恢復到最佳音準（最大耐蝕狀態）。而紅鏽就像鋼琴弦上的鏽斑，顏色從淺到深代表問題從輕到重。淺色的擦擦就好，深色的可能要換弦（重新處理表面）。
blocks.en: Passivation is like tuning a piano regularly: the piano strings (the stainless steel surface) drift away from their best condition with use, and the tuner (the passivation procedure) restores them to the best pitch (maximum corrosion resistance). Rouge is like rust spots on the strings, with the color from light to dark showing the problem from mild to severe. Light-colored spots can simply be wiped off; dark ones may need a new string (re-treatment of the surface).

blocks.zh: 11.9.7 Castings/Forgings & 11.9.8 Surface Finish of Stainless Steels 11.9.7 鑄件/鍛件 & 11.9.8 不鏽鋼表面處理
blocks.en: 11.9.7 Castings/Forgings & 11.9.8 Surface Finish of Stainless Steels

blocks.zh: 電拋光 (Electro-Polishing) 的六大優勢
blocks.en: The Six Advantages of Electropolishing

blocks.zh: 電拋光不只是「讓表面更光亮」——它有六個關鍵功能：
blocks.en: Electropolishing is not just about "making the surface shinier". It has six key functions:

blocks.zh: 縮小表面積：平滑的山峰→減少微生物可附著的面積
blocks.en: Reduces surface area: smoothed peaks mean less area for microorganisms to attach to

blocks.zh: 達到衛生級表面：滿足 cGMP 清洗要求
blocks.en: Achieves a sanitary surface: meets cGMP cleaning requirements

blocks.zh: 清潔表面：移除機械拋光殘留物
blocks.en: Cleans the surface: removes residues left by mechanical polishing

blocks.zh: 同時鈍化：形成富鉻保護層——一舉兩得
blocks.en: Passivates at the same time: forms a chromium-rich protective layer, two benefits in one step

blocks.zh: 揭露隱藏缺陷：機械拋光有「塗抹效應」(smearing effect)，會把缺陷蓋住，EP 反而能揭露
blocks.en: Reveals hidden defects: mechanical polishing has a "smearing effect" that covers up defects, whereas EP exposes them

blocks.zh: 移除深層雜質：機械拋光形成的褶層下方可能藏有雜質
blocks.en: Removes deep impurities: impurities may be hidden under the folded layer created by mechanical polishing

blocks.zh: 鑄件 vs 鍛件的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Differences between Castings and Forgings

blocks.zh: 在選擇容器零件時，鍛件 (Forgings) 優於鑄件 (Castings)：
blocks.en: When selecting vessel components, forgings are preferable to castings:

blocks.zh: 鑄件含較多鐵素體 (ferrite)→更容易產生紅鏽
blocks.en: Castings contain more ferrite, so they are more prone to rouging

blocks.zh: 鑄件多孔、組織粗糙→最多只能拋光到 #4
blocks.en: Castings are porous with a coarse structure, and can be polished to #4 at most

blocks.zh: 鍛件組織緻密→可拋光到 #8 鏡面
blocks.en: Forgings have a dense structure and can be polished to a #8 mirror finish

blocks.zh: 結論：高純度水系統中，與水接觸的零件應優先使用鍛件。
blocks.en: Conclusion: in high-purity water systems, parts in contact with the water should preferably be forgings.

blocks.zh: 表面粗糙度換算表
blocks.en: Surface Roughness Conversion Table

blocks.zh: Ra (Roughness Average)：表面粗糙度平均值。製藥業常見規格為 Ra ≤ 25 micro-inch (0.6 μm) 機械拋光 + 電拋光 (EP)。許多 WFI 系統要求 Ra ≤ 15 micro-inch (0.4 μm)。
blocks.en: Ra (Roughness Average): the average value of surface roughness. A common pharmaceutical specification is Ra ≤ 25 micro-inch (0.6 μm) mechanical polish plus electropolishing (EP). Many WFI systems require Ra ≤ 15 micro-inch (0.4 μm).

blocks.zh: 11.9.9 Stainless Steel Distribution Piping & Bends 11.9.9 不鏽鋼分配管路與彎管
blocks.en: 11.9.9 Stainless Steel Distribution Piping & Bends

blocks.zh: 彎頭策略：60% 焊接減量
blocks.en: Bend Strategy: 60% Fewer Welds

blocks.zh: 這是一個非常有價值的成本與品質優化建議：
blocks.en: This is a very valuable cost and quality optimization suggestion:

blocks.zh: 傳統做法：每個轉彎用焊接彎頭 → 一個彎頭 = 2 個焊縫
blocks.en: Traditional approach: use a welded elbow at every turn, so one elbow = 2 welds

blocks.zh: 優化做法：使用 40 ft 長管 + 大弧度彎管 (sweeping bends) → 減少焊接數量達 60%
blocks.en: Optimized approach: use 40 ft tube lengths with sweeping bends, reducing the number of welds by up to 60%

blocks.zh: 每少一條焊縫 = 少一個潛在缺陷點 + 少一個微生物可能的駐足處
blocks.en: Every weld eliminated = one fewer potential defect site + one fewer place for microorganisms to settle

blocks.zh: 一個大型 WFI 系統可能有 500+ 個焊縫。減少 60% 意味著少了 300 個需要檢查、記錄、驗證的焊點。這對施工品質和驗證效率的提升是巨大的。
blocks.en: A large WFI system may have 500+ welds. A 60% reduction means 300 fewer welds to inspect, document and validate. The improvement in construction quality and validation efficiency is enormous.

blocks.zh: 管壁厚度規格
blocks.en: Wall Thickness Specifications

blocks.zh: 16 gauge (0.065 in / 1.65 mm)：適用於 1"-3" 管徑
blocks.en: 16 gauge (0.065 in / 1.65 mm): for 1"-3" tube sizes

blocks.zh: 14 gauge (0.083 in / 2.11 mm)：適用於 4" 管徑
blocks.en: 14 gauge (0.083 in / 2.11 mm): for 4" tube size

blocks.zh: 更大管徑依應用和位置選擇適當壁厚。選擇的原則是：壁厚要足以承受壓力和焊接熱量，但不能太厚導致焊接困難。
blocks.en: For larger sizes, choose an appropriate wall thickness for the application and location. The principle is that the wall must be thick enough to withstand pressure and welding heat, but not so thick that welding becomes difficult.

blocks.zh: 11.9.11 Types of Non-Metallic Materials (PVDF) 11.9.11 非金屬材料類型 (PVDF)
blocks.en: 11.9.11 Types of Non-Metallic Materials (PVDF)

blocks.zh: PVDF 的壓力-溫度限制
blocks.en: Pressure-Temperature Limits of PVDF

blocks.zh: 這是選用 PVDF 時最關鍵的工程考量。塑膠材料的強度會隨溫度升高而急劇下降：
blocks.en: This is the most critical engineering consideration when selecting PVDF. The strength of plastic materials drops sharply as temperature rises:

blocks.zh: 68°C → 230 psi（正常操作，強度充足）
blocks.en: 68°C → 230 psi (normal operation, adequate strength)

blocks.zh: 149°C → 50 psi（蒸汽滅菌時，強度大幅下降）
blocks.en: 149°C → 50 psi (during steam sterilization, strength drops substantially)

blocks.zh: 設計要點：65°C 以上操作時必須使用連續支撐（角鐵或等效結構），防止管路因軟化而下垂改變坡度。熱脹冷縮也比不鏽鋼顯著得多，需要在設計中納入膨脹迴圈或補償措施。
blocks.en: Design point: For operation above 65°C, continuous support (angle iron or an equivalent structure) must be used to prevent the pipe from sagging as it softens and changing the slope. Thermal expansion is also much greater than for stainless steel, so expansion loops or other compensation measures must be included in the design.

blocks.zh: PVDF 就像高級矽膠——化學上幾乎什麼都不怕，但物理上「軟」。不鏽鋼像盔甲——硬度夠但有化學弱點（氯離子、rouge）。選材就像選裝備：如果你的水系統溫度不太高、不需要蒸汽滅菌，PVDF 可能是更省心的選擇（不用鈍化、不會 rouge）；但如果系統需要承受高溫高壓，不鏽鋼的「硬度」優勢就無可取代。
blocks.en: PVDF is like high-grade silicone: chemically it fears almost nothing, but physically it is "soft". Stainless steel is like armor: hard enough but with chemical weaknesses (chloride ions, rouge). Selecting materials is like choosing equipment: if your water system does not run too hot and does not need steam sterilization, PVDF may be the more worry-free choice (no passivation, no rouge). But if the system must withstand high temperature and pressure, the "hardness" advantage of stainless steel cannot be replaced.

blocks.zh: 11.10 Design of a WFI/Purified Water Distribution System 11.10 注射用水/純化水分配系統設計
blocks.en: 11.10 Design of a WFI/Purified Water Distribution System

blocks.zh: 配水系統設計關鍵參數
blocks.en: Key Design Parameters of the Distribution System

blocks.zh: 管路坡度：最小 1/16 in./ft (0.52 cm/m)——確保自然排空
blocks.en: Pipe slope: minimum 1/16 in./ft (0.52 cm/m), to ensure natural drainage

blocks.zh: 閥門安裝角度：與垂直方向成 60°——優化排水性
blocks.en: Valve installation angle: 60° from the vertical, to optimize drainability

blocks.zh: Dead Leg 限制：最大 6 倍主管管徑——超過此值水會停滯
blocks.en: Dead leg limit: maximum 6 times the main pipe diameter; beyond this the water stagnates

blocks.zh: 法蘭型式：Tri-clamp 衛生連接——易拆卸清洗
blocks.en: Flange type: tri-clamp sanitary connections, easy to disassemble and clean

blocks.zh: 隔膜材質：PTFE Teflon——適用高溫至 177°C
blocks.en: Diaphragm material: PTFE (Teflon), suitable for high temperatures up to 177°C

blocks.zh: Dead Leg 的 6D 法則
blocks.en: The 6D Rule for Dead Legs

blocks.zh: 「6 diameter dead leg」是高純度水系統中最常被稽核員檢查的設計準則之一。舉例：如果主管管徑是 2 英寸，則從主管中心到支管閥門中心的距離不得超過 12 英寸 (6 x 2")。
blocks.en: The "6 diameter dead leg" is one of the design criteria most often checked by auditors for high-purity water systems. For example, if the main pipe diameter is 2 inches, the distance from the center of the main pipe to the center of the branch valve must not exceed 12 inches (6 x 2").

blocks.zh: 為什麼重要：Dead leg 中的水是靜止的，無法被主管路的湍流帶走微生物和生物膜。FDA 查廠時會拿捲尺量——這不是理論問題，是實際執行問題。
blocks.en: Why it matters: Water in a dead leg is stagnant, so turbulence in the main line cannot carry away microorganisms and biofilm. FDA inspectors will measure with a tape measure: this is not a theoretical issue but a practical one.

blocks.zh: 坡度驗證時機：ISPE 特別提醒要在「after hanging and before insulation」時驗證坡度。一旦包了保溫層就看不到了，而且保溫層的重量可能改變管路的坡度。
blocks.en: When to verify the slope: ISPE specifically reminds us to verify the slope "after hanging and before insulation". Once the insulation is on, it can no longer be seen, and the weight of the insulation may change the slope of the pipe.

blocks.zh: 為什麼閥門要以 60° 安裝而非垂直或水平？如果安裝角度錯誤會造成什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why should valves be installed at 60° rather than vertically or horizontally? What problems arise if the installation angle is wrong?

blocks.zh: 如果系統設計中有一個 dead leg 超過 6D 限制但無法避免，你會建議什麼工程補償措施？
blocks.en: If a dead leg in the system design exceeds the 6D limit and cannot be avoided, what engineering compensating measures would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 11.11 Fabrication of a WFI/PW Distribution System 11.11 注射用水/純化水分配系統製作
blocks.en: 11.11 Fabrication of a WFI/PW Distribution System

blocks.zh: 施工品質保證程序總覽
blocks.en: Overview of Fabrication Quality Assurance Procedures

blocks.zh: ISPE 在這裡建立了一個從採購到安裝的完整品質鏈：
blocks.en: ISPE establishes here a complete quality chain from procurement to installation:

blocks.zh: 採購控制：AVL (Approved Vendor List) + 指定料號
blocks.en: Procurement control: AVL (Approved Vendor List) + specified part numbers

blocks.zh: 進料檢驗：核對提貨單、檢查損傷
blocks.en: Incoming inspection: check the bill of lading and inspect for damage

blocks.zh: 準備程序：切割、端面加工、清潔
blocks.en: Preparation procedure: cutting, end facing, and cleaning

blocks.zh: 保護程序：2 小時規則——未焊接的管端必須封袋
blocks.en: Protection procedure: the 2-hour rule, under which unwelded tube ends must be bagged

blocks.zh: 焊接程序：在潔淨室中、氬氣保護下進行
blocks.en: Welding procedure: performed in a clean room under argon shielding

blocks.zh: 「2 小時規則」與碳鋼隔離
blocks.en: The "2-Hour Rule" and Carbon Steel Segregation

blocks.zh: 兩個容易被忽略但極其重要的規定：
blocks.en: Two requirements that are easily overlooked but extremely important:

blocks.zh: 1. 兩小時封袋規則：準備好的管端如果不在 2 小時內焊接，必須用透明塑膠袋封住。這是因為暴露在空氣中的潔淨管端會累積灰塵、油氣和水氣，汙染焊接區域。
blocks.en: 1. The two-hour bagging rule: If a prepared tube end is not welded within 2 hours, it must be sealed in a clear plastic bag. This is because a clean tube end exposed to air accumulates dust, oil vapor and moisture, which contaminate the weld area.

blocks.zh: 2. 碳鋼零容忍：施工區域不得有任何曾用於碳鋼的設備。碳鋼微粒即使是微量的，嵌入不鏽鋼表面後就成為腐蝕起點。很多承包商不理解這一點，會用同一台砂輪機「先磨碳鋼再磨不鏽鋼」——這是絕對不可以的。
blocks.en: 2. Zero tolerance for carbon steel: No equipment that has ever been used on carbon steel may be present in the work area. Even trace carbon steel particles, once embedded in the stainless steel surface, become corrosion initiation sites. Many contractors do not understand this and use the same grinder to "grind carbon steel first and then stainless steel". This is absolutely not allowed.

blocks.zh: 氬氣純度要求
blocks.en: Argon Purity Requirements

blocks.zh: 99.999% 純度（5N），水分 <1 ppm，氧氣 <2 ppm。
blocks.en: 99.999% purity (5N), moisture <1 ppm, oxygen <2 ppm.

blocks.zh: 這個要求比一般工業焊接的氬氣純度（99.95%~99.99%）高一個等級。原因是：即使微量的氧氣或水分，在焊接高溫下都會與不鏽鋼表面反應，造成氧化變色——這正是後文所列多種焊接缺陷的根本原因之一。
blocks.en: This requirement is one grade higher than the argon purity used in general industrial welding (99.95% to 99.99%). The reason is that even trace amounts of oxygen or moisture react with the stainless steel surface at welding temperatures and cause oxidation discoloration, which is one of the root causes of many of the weld defects listed later.

blocks.zh: 液態氬氣 (Dewar) 優先：因為液態氬氣的純度天生就高（雜質在液化過程中已被分離）。再加上 Nanochem 等純化器，可以把汙染物降到 ppb 等級。
blocks.en: Liquid argon (Dewar) is preferred: Liquid argon is inherently high in purity (impurities are separated out during liquefaction). Adding a purifier such as Nanochem can reduce contaminants to the ppb level.

blocks.zh: 潔淨施工區域管控要點
blocks.en: Key Controls for the Clean Fabrication Area

blocks.zh: ISPE 推薦的潔淨施工規格，其實借鏡自半導體業的做法：
blocks.en: The clean fabrication specification recommended by ISPE is actually borrowed from semiconductor industry practice:

blocks.zh: 過濾通風：控制空氣中的微粒
blocks.en: Filtered ventilation: controls airborne particles

blocks.zh: 黏性地墊 (Sticky Mats)：入口處除塵
blocks.en: Sticky mats: remove dust at the entrance

blocks.zh: 受限進入：只有經過培訓的人員可進入
blocks.en: Restricted access: only trained personnel may enter

blocks.zh: 個人防護：鞋套 + 潔淨室手套（防指紋油脂）
blocks.en: Personal protection: shoe covers + clean room gloves (to prevent fingerprint oils)

blocks.zh: 焊後封袋：組裝件焊完立刻封袋，到現場才拆
blocks.en: Bagging after welding: bag assemblies immediately after welding and unbag them only on site

blocks.zh: 「Validated Process」的重要概念
blocks.en: The Concept of a "Validated Process"

blocks.zh: 由於管路內部焊縫的檢查往往不可能或不實際（管子太長、位置難以到達），ISPE 的策略是：與其逐條檢查結果，不如驗證整個製程。
blocks.en: Because inspecting the internal welds of a pipe is often impossible or impractical (the pipe is too long or the location is hard to reach), ISPE's strategy is: rather than inspecting each result, validate the whole process.

blocks.zh: 這是典型的「Process Validation」思維：
blocks.en: This is typical "process validation" thinking:

blocks.zh: 精確的焊接設備（validated instrument）
blocks.en: Precise welding equipment (validated instrument)

blocks.zh: 惰性氣體環境（inert environment）
blocks.en: Inert gas environment (inert environment)

blocks.zh: 潔淨的接觸面（clean contact surface）
blocks.en: Clean contact surfaces (clean contact surface)

blocks.zh: 經資格認證的焊工（qualified welder）
blocks.en: Qualified welders (qualified welder)

blocks.zh: 當這四個條件都被驗證和控制時，就可以合理地相信每一條焊縫都符合品質要求——無需百分之百檢查。
blocks.en: When all four conditions are validated and controlled, one can reasonably trust that every weld meets the quality requirements, without 100% inspection.

blocks.zh: 11.11.4-11.11.5 Orbital Welding & Borescoping 11.11.4-11.11.5 軌道焊接與管孔鏡檢查
blocks.en: 11.11.4-11.11.5 Orbital Welding & Borescoping

blocks.zh: 軌道焊接 (Orbital Welding) 原理
blocks.en: Principle of Orbital Welding

blocks.zh: 為什麼是「軌道」：焊頭沿著管外圓周自動旋轉（orbits around the tube），不需要人工操控焊槍方向。
blocks.en: Why "orbital": The weld head rotates automatically around the outer circumference of the tube (orbits around the tube), so no manual control of the torch direction is needed.

blocks.zh: 關鍵特徵：
blocks.en: Key features:

blocks.zh: 無填料 (Autogenous)：不加焊條，靠母材本身熔融結合
blocks.en: Autogenous: no filler wire is added; the joint is formed by fusion of the base metal itself

blocks.zh: TIG/GTAW 製程：鎢極惰性氣體保護焊
blocks.en: TIG/GTAW process: tungsten inert gas / gas tungsten arc welding

blocks.zh: 可程式化：電流、速度、脈衝等參數可精確設定並記錄
blocks.en: Programmable: current, speed, pulsing and other parameters can be set precisely and recorded

blocks.zh: 可重現：同樣參數 + 同樣材料 = 同樣品質的焊縫
blocks.en: Reproducible: same parameters + same material = same weld quality

blocks.zh: 內視鏡 (Borescope) 檢查策略
blocks.en: Borescope Inspection Strategy

blocks.zh: ISPE 對內視鏡檢查的態度很務實：
blocks.en: ISPE takes a pragmatic attitude toward borescope inspection:

blocks.zh: 不是每條焊縫都要做——因為製程已經被驗證
blocks.en: Not every weld needs to be examined, because the process has been validated

blocks.zh: 建議用於：焊接資格認證 (qualification) 和每日開工檢查 (daily restart)
blocks.en: Recommended for: welder qualification and the daily restart check

blocks.zh: 錄影每條焊縫不必要——ISPE 明確說「difficult to justify」
blocks.en: Recording every weld is not necessary: ISPE explicitly says it is "difficult to justify"

blocks.zh: 實務建議：制定一個抽檢計劃，例如每個焊工每天前 3 條焊縫做 borescope，加上隨機抽檢 5-10%。這比「全檢」更有成本效益，同時提供足夠的品質保證。
blocks.en: Practical advice: Establish a sampling plan, for example borescope the first 3 welds of each welder each day, plus random sampling of 5-10%. This is more cost-effective than 100% inspection while still providing sufficient quality assurance.

blocks.zh: 軌道焊接就像精密的 3D 列印機在管子接口上「印」出一圈完美的金屬融合線。人工焊接像手寫書法——高手可以寫得很美，但品質不穩定；軌道焊接像印表機——每次輸出幾乎一模一樣。這也是為什麼可以用「製程驗證」取代「逐一檢查」：既然機器每次做的都一樣，你只要驗證設定是對的，就可以信任產出。
blocks.en: Orbital welding is like a precision 3D printer "printing" a perfect ring of fused metal at the tube joint. Manual welding is like handwritten calligraphy: a master can write beautifully, but the quality is not stable. Orbital welding is like a printer: every output is almost identical. This is also why "process validation" can replace "inspecting every weld": since the machine does the same thing every time, you only need to verify that the settings are right in order to trust the output.

blocks.zh: 11.11.6 Weld Criteria & Welder Qualification 11.11.6 焊接標準與焊工資格
blocks.en: 11.11.6 Weld Criteria & Welder Qualification

blocks.zh: 焊縫品質八大準則
blocks.en: Eight Weld Quality Criteria

blocks.zh: 完全熔透 (Full Penetration)：焊縫必須貫穿整個管壁厚度，360°無死角
blocks.en: Full penetration: the weld must penetrate the entire wall thickness, 360° with no gaps

blocks.zh: 無縫隙 (No Crevices)：任何縫隙都會成為縫隙腐蝕和微生物棲息地
blocks.en: No crevices: any crevice becomes a site for crevice corrosion and microbial habitation

blocks.zh: 外部平坦：不可凹陷 (concave)
blocks.en: Flat on the outside: must not be concave

blocks.zh: 內部焊道均勻：盡量無凸起
blocks.en: Uniform inner bead: as free of protrusion as possible

blocks.zh: 內部不可凹陷：凹陷處會積水成為死角
blocks.en: No concavity on the inside: a concave area traps water and becomes a dead spot

blocks.zh: 無氧化變色：內部焊縫必須銀白色
blocks.en: No oxidation discoloration: the inner weld must be silvery white

blocks.zh: 對齊精度：管壁偏移 ≤ 0.003 in. (0.076 mm)——比一根頭髮還細
blocks.en: Alignment accuracy: wall offset ≤ 0.003 in. (0.076 mm), finer than a single hair

blocks.zh: 焊道寬度：標稱 1/8 in. (3.2 mm)
blocks.en: Bead width: nominal 1/8 in. (3.2 mm)

blocks.zh: 焊工資格認證
blocks.en: Welder Qualification

blocks.zh: ASME B31.3 + Section IX 是製藥管路焊接資格的標準依據。每位焊工必須：
blocks.en: ASME B31.3 + Section IX are the standard basis for qualifying pharmaceutical piping welders. Every welder must:

blocks.zh: 通過特定金屬類型和焊接方法的認證
blocks.en: Be qualified for the specific metal type and welding method

blocks.zh: 持有正式的焊工資格證書
blocks.en: Hold a formal welder qualification certificate

blocks.zh: 每個工作日開始前重新資格驗證
blocks.en: Be requalified before the start of each working day

blocks.zh: 更換管徑時重新資格驗證
blocks.en: Be requalified when the tube size changes

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：「每日開工檢查」(daily restart check) 不是走形式——它確保焊接設備經過一夜停機後仍在最佳狀態，同時也驗證焊工的手感沒有因為休息而偏差。第一條焊縫用 borescope 檢查確認品質後，才能繼續正式焊接。
blocks.en: Practical reminder: The "daily restart check" is not a formality. It ensures that the welding equipment is still in optimal condition after being shut down overnight, and also verifies that the welder's skill has not drifted after a break. Only after the first weld has been checked with a borescope and its quality confirmed can production welding continue.

blocks.zh: 0.003 in. 偏移容差的意義
blocks.en: The Significance of the 0.003 in. Offset Tolerance

blocks.zh: 0.003 英寸 = 0.076 mm，大約是一張影印紙的厚度。這個容差之所以如此嚴格，是因為管壁錯位會在焊縫內部形成一個「階梯」(step)，而這個階梯就是一個潛在的微生物附著點和縫隙腐蝕起始點。要達到這種精度，除了高品質的軌道焊接設備外，管材本身的同心度 (concentricity) 和壁厚均勻度也必須非常好。
blocks.en: 0.003 inch = 0.076 mm, roughly the thickness of a sheet of copier paper. The tolerance is so strict because a wall misalignment creates a "step" inside the weld, and this step is a potential site for microbial attachment and a starting point for crevice corrosion. To achieve this precision, besides high-quality orbital welding equipment, the concentricity and wall thickness uniformity of the tube itself must also be very good.

blocks.zh: 11.11.7 Weld Defects Examples 11.11.7 焊接缺陷範例
blocks.en: 11.11.7 Weld Defects Examples

blocks.zh: 氣體保護問題佔 5/14 = 36%
blocks.en: Gas Shielding Problems Account for 5/14 = 36%

blocks.zh: 統計 14 種缺陷，會發現有 5 種（超過三分之一）都與氬氣保護有關。這告訴我們：管好保護氣體就能預防三分之一以上的焊接問題。
blocks.en: Of the 14 defect types, 5 (more than one third) are related to argon shielding. This tells us: controlling the shielding gas well can prevent more than one third of welding problems.

blocks.zh: 氣體管理三要件：
blocks.en: Three elements of gas management:

blocks.zh: 純度：99.999%，使用液態氬氣 + 純化器
blocks.en: Purity: 99.999%, using liquid argon + a purifier

blocks.zh: 流量：監控焊接現場的實際流量，而非只看調壓器設定
blocks.en: Flow: monitor the actual flow at the weld site, not just the regulator setting

blocks.zh: 密封：確保氣管無洩漏、無被壓扁，管路兩端完全密封
blocks.en: Sealing: make sure the gas hose has no leaks and is not crushed, and that both ends of the pipe are completely sealed

blocks.zh: 「Sugaring」——最嚴重的氣體保護失敗
blocks.en: "Sugaring": the Most Serious Gas Shielding Failure

blocks.zh: 「Sugaring」是焊縫內部因完全缺乏保護氣而產生的粗糙、顆粒狀氧化物，外觀像結晶砂糖。這是最嚴重的焊接缺陷之一，因為：
blocks.en: "Sugaring" is a rough, granular oxide formed inside the weld because of a complete lack of shielding gas, and it looks like crystallized sugar. It is one of the most serious weld defects because:

blocks.zh: 粗糙的表面是微生物生物膜的理想棲息地
blocks.en: A rough surface is an ideal habitat for microbial biofilm

blocks.zh: 無法透過清洗或鈍化修復
blocks.en: It cannot be repaired by cleaning or passivation

blocks.zh: 唯一的解決方案是切除焊縫重新焊接
blocks.en: The only solution is to cut out the weld and re-weld it

blocks.zh: 如果你在一天的焊接工作中，第 50 條焊縫突然出現藍色變色，最可能的根本原因是什麼？你會檢查哪些項目？
blocks.en: If on one day of welding the 50th weld suddenly shows blue discoloration, what is the most likely root cause? What would you check?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議使用「dedicated circuit」（專用迴路）？在施工現場如何確保這一點？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend a "dedicated circuit"? How can this be ensured on a construction site?

blocks.zh: 如果一條焊縫的外部看起來完美，但 borescope 顯示內部有針孔，可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: If the outside of a weld looks perfect but the borescope shows pinholes inside, what are the possible causes?

blocks.zh: 11.11.8 PVDF Welding 11.11.8 PVDF 焊接
blocks.en: 11.11.8 PVDF Welding

blocks.zh: PVDF 焊接 vs SS 焊接
blocks.en: PVDF Welding vs SS Welding

blocks.zh: PVDF 焊接與不鏽鋼焊接有本質區別：
blocks.en: PVDF welding is fundamentally different from stainless steel welding:

blocks.zh: 原理不同：SS 是電弧熔融→PVDF 是熱板/紅外線熱熔融
blocks.en: Different principle: SS uses arc fusion, whereas PVDF uses hot plate / infrared heat fusion

blocks.zh: 無需保護氣：塑膠不會氧化，省去氬氣系統
blocks.en: No shielding gas needed: plastic does not oxidize, so no argon system is required

blocks.zh: 無內焊道：彈性壓力元件支撐內壁，避免形成突出的焊道
blocks.en: No inner bead: an elastic pressure element supports the inner wall and prevents a protruding bead from forming

blocks.zh: 均質結合：熱塑性材料在分子層級融合，接合品質非常一致
blocks.en: Homogeneous joint: the thermoplastic fuses at the molecular level, so joint quality is very consistent

blocks.zh: PVDF 焊接的最大優勢是「完全沒有內焊道」(no inner bead)——不鏽鋼焊接即使做到最好，內部仍會有一個微凸的焊道，而 PVDF 的內壁可以做到幾乎完全平滑。
blocks.en: The biggest advantage of PVDF welding is that there is "no inner bead": even the best stainless steel weld still leaves a slightly raised bead inside, whereas the inner wall of PVDF can be made almost perfectly smooth.

blocks.zh: 11.11.9 Remedial Action for Defective Welds 11.11.9 缺陷焊接的矯正措施
blocks.en: 11.11.9 Remedial Action for Defective Welds

blocks.zh: 「零修補」原則 — 最嚴格的焊接品管
blocks.en: The "Zero Repair" Principle: the Strictest Weld Quality Control

blocks.zh: 「Rewelding or weld repairs are not acceptable」——這句話的意思是：如果一條焊縫不合格，你不能在原位重新焊接或補焊。必須把整個焊縫切除，重新準備管端，然後重新焊接。
blocks.en: "Rewelding or weld repairs are not acceptable": This means that if a weld is rejected, you cannot re-weld or repair it in place. The entire weld must be cut out, the tube ends prepared again, and the joint welded again.

blocks.zh: 原因：
blocks.en: Reasons:

blocks.zh: 重焊或補焊會在同一位置造成多次熱影響，改變金屬微觀結構
blocks.en: Rewelding or weld repair subjects the same location to repeated heat effects, which alters the metal microstructure

blocks.zh: 多次加熱可能導致碳化鉻析出（敏化），增加晶間腐蝕風險
blocks.en: Repeated heating may cause chromium carbide precipitation (sensitization), increasing the risk of intergranular corrosion

blocks.zh: 補焊無法保證與原焊道的完美融合，可能形成隱藏的縫隙
blocks.en: A repair weld cannot guarantee perfect fusion with the original bead and may create hidden crevices

blocks.zh: 焊縫替換 7 步驟
blocks.en: The 7 Steps of Weld Replacement

blocks.zh: 注意第 (g) 步——替換焊縫必須在焊縫編號後加「R」字尾。例如原始焊縫 W-047 被替換後，新焊縫編號為 W-047R。這確保了完整的追溯性 (traceability)：任何人看到「R」就知道這是替換焊縫，可以追查原始缺陷報告。
blocks.en: Note step (g): a replacement weld must have the suffix "R" added after the weld number. For example, when original weld W-047 is replaced, the new weld is numbered W-047R. This ensures full traceability: anyone seeing the "R" knows this is a replacement weld and can trace back to the original defect report.

blocks.zh: 第 (b) 步「retain section for further inspection」也很重要——保留被切除的焊縫段可以做根本原因分析 (RCA)，避免同類缺陷再次發生。
blocks.en: Step (b), "retain section for further inspection", is also important: keeping the cut-out weld section allows root cause analysis (RCA) and helps prevent the same defect from recurring.

blocks.zh: 11.11.10 Joints Using Sanitary Clamps 11.11.10 衛生夾管接頭
blocks.en: 11.11.10 Joints Using Sanitary Clamps

blocks.zh: 衛生夾具 (Tri-Clamp) 的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Sanitary Clamps (Tri-Clamp)

blocks.zh: 衛生夾具是高純度水系統中唯一可接受的「非焊接」連接方式。它的設計特點：
blocks.en: Sanitary clamps are the only acceptable "non-welded" connection method in high-purity water systems. Their design features:

blocks.zh: 快速拆裝：不需要特殊工具，方便維護和檢查
blocks.en: Quick assembly and disassembly: no special tools needed, convenient for maintenance and inspection

blocks.zh: 平滑內壁：兩個對接面 + EPDM/PTFE 墊片，形成連續平滑的內表面
blocks.en: Smooth inner wall: two mating faces + an EPDM/PTFE gasket form a continuous smooth inner surface

blocks.zh: 可 CIP 清洗：不必拆開就能用線上清洗系統處理
blocks.en: CIP-cleanable: can be treated by the clean-in-place system without disassembly

blocks.zh: 防洩漏：適當的夾具力矩可確保密封
blocks.en: Leak-tight: appropriate clamp torque ensures sealing

blocks.zh: 使用場景
blocks.en: Typical Applications

blocks.zh: Tri-clamp 連接用於所有「需要可拆卸」的位置：
blocks.en: Tri-clamp connections are used wherever a position "needs to be removable":

blocks.zh: 閥門連接：閥門可能需要定期更換隔膜
blocks.en: Valve connections: valve diaphragms may need periodic replacement

blocks.zh: 感測器安裝：溫度、壓力、電導度感測器需要校準和更換
blocks.en: Sensor installation: temperature, pressure and conductivity sensors need calibration and replacement

blocks.zh: 無法軌道焊接的位置：空間受限或最終連接點
blocks.en: Locations where orbital welding is not possible: confined spaces or final connection points

blocks.zh: 注意：墊片是最弱的環節——必須定期檢查和更換，特別是在高溫 WFI 系統中，墊片老化速度較快。
blocks.en: Note: The gasket is the weakest link and must be inspected and replaced regularly, especially in hot WFI systems, where gaskets age faster.

blocks.zh: 本章重點摘要 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 材料選擇：316L 是首選，因為低碳含量降低晶間腐蝕風險，Mo 增強抗點蝕能力。所有零件盡量使用同一 Heat Number 以確保焊接一致性
blocks.en: Material selection: 316L is the first choice because its low carbon content reduces the risk of intergranular corrosion and Mo increases pitting resistance. Use the same heat number for all parts wherever possible to ensure welding consistency

blocks.zh: 硫含量控制：理想範圍 0.005%-0.02%。配合件硫含量不匹配是焊接品質的最大威脅之一
blocks.en: Sulfur control: the ideal range is 0.005%-0.02%. Sulfur mismatch between mating parts is one of the biggest threats to weld quality

blocks.zh: 五大腐蝕類型：晶間、電偶、接觸、點蝕、應力開裂——每種都有特定的預防策略
blocks.en: Five corrosion types: intergranular, galvanic, contact, pitting, and stress corrosion cracking, each with its own specific prevention strategy

blocks.zh: 鈍化與紅鏽：鈍化是恢復保護膜的關鍵程序；Rouge 顏色從淺到深代表問題嚴重程度遞增
blocks.en: Passivation and rouge: passivation is the key procedure for restoring the protective film; rouge color from light to dark indicates increasing severity

blocks.zh: 表面處理：電拋光 (EP) 優於純機械拋光，能同時清潔、平滑化、鈍化，並揭露隱藏缺陷
blocks.en: Surface finish: electropolishing (EP) is better than mechanical polishing alone; it cleans, smooths and passivates at the same time, and reveals hidden defects

blocks.zh: PVDF 替代方案：化學惰性、無 rouge 風險、表面等同 EP，但高溫下強度下降需連續支撐
blocks.en: PVDF alternative: chemically inert, no rouge risk, surface equivalent to EP, but strength falls at high temperature so continuous support is needed

blocks.zh: 施工環境：必須在潔淨室中進行，碳鋼工具零容忍，2 小時封袋規則，人員穿戴鞋套和手套
blocks.en: Fabrication environment: must be a clean room, zero tolerance for carbon steel tools, the 2-hour bagging rule, and personnel wearing shoe covers and gloves

blocks.zh: 軌道焊接：業界標準，無填料 TIG 製程。Borescope 用於資格認證和每日抽檢，非全檢
blocks.en: Orbital welding: the industry standard, an autogenous TIG process. Borescope is used for qualification and daily sampling, not 100% inspection

blocks.zh: 焊縫品質：八大準則，偏移容差 0.003 in.。14 種常見缺陷中 36% 與氣體保護有關
blocks.en: Weld quality: eight criteria, with an offset tolerance of 0.003 in. 36% of the 14 common defects are related to gas shielding

blocks.zh: 缺陷處理：零修補原則——不合格焊縫必須切除重做，不可在原位修補。替換焊縫編號加「R」字尾
blocks.en: Defect handling: the zero repair principle: a rejected weld must be cut out and redone, not repaired in place. A replacement weld number gets the suffix "R"

blocks.zh: 衛生夾具：用於所有需要可拆卸的連接位置（閥門、感測器、最終接口）
blocks.en: Sanitary clamps: used wherever a connection must be removable (valves, sensors, final connections)
